newsitem.title: CANADA: Wascana Energy opens data rooms after Talisman bid.
newsitem.headline: Wascana Energy opens data rooms after Talisman bid.

text.p: Wascana Energy Inc said on Tuesday it had officially received a C$1.7 billion takeover offer from Talisman Energy Inc and had opened its data rooms to "aggressively pursue all available alternatives".
Wascana said in a statement it is recommending shareholders wait until the board of directors reviews the offer and provides additional information,including any board recommendation.
"Wascana has been in contact with a number of interested parties with respect to the offer since it was announced," said Wascana chairman Ted Hanlon.

"Having now finally received the offer, the company has opened data rooms and will aggressively pursue all available alternatives and continue to work in the best interests of our shareholders," Hanlon said.
Talisman has said it will offer C$18.50 cash or 0.41 of a Talisman share for each share of Wascana. It would be the largest takeover in Canada's oil and gas sector since 1994.
